sunlight.label: Sunlight
sunlight.text: Share of the year the Sun is more than half above the local horizon, including terrain. 50% is typical on the Moon; polar peaks of light exceed 70%.
sunlight.formula: sunlit = visible fraction of the solar disk > 0.5, hourly over 2028

longest_night.label: Longest night
longest_night.text: Longest continuous stretch without sunlight in 2028. Equatorial nights last about 355 hours (14.8 days).

earth_contact.label: Earth contact
earth_contact.text: Share of the year Earth is at least 1 degree above the local terrain horizon, so a direct radio link is possible.

longest_blackout.label: Longest blackout
longest_blackout.text: Longest continuous stretch with no direct line of sight to Earth.
longest_blackout.formula: longest run of hours without Earth contact

temperature.label: Temperature
temperature.text: Modelled surface temperature range (simple equilibrium model, not a measurement). Daytime highs reach about 390 K at the equator; permanently shadowed regions stay near 40 K. Polar lit-site maxima and nights are conservative versus LRO Diviner averages.
temperature.formula: T = ((1-A) F / (eps sigma))^(1/4), floored at 95 K (40 K in shadow)

slope.label: Slope
slope.text: Mean ground slope across the plot. Plots with too little gentle ground are Off market for landing.
slope.formula: landing_safe = share of area under 8 deg >= 25%

land_type.label: Land type
land_type.text: Terrain category: Highlands, Mare, Crater rim, Crater floor, Far side, Permanently shadowed region (PSR) or Peak of light.
land_type.formula: rule-based on lighting, position and elevation

ice.label: Ice access
ice.text: Distance to the nearest permanently shadowed region, where water ice can survive.
ice.formula: distance to nearest cell with sunlit < 1%

viability.label: Viability
viability.text: Overall 0-100 score combining landing safety, power, communications, comfort and views. It drives the Moonstimate.
viability.formula: 100 * weighted mean of sub-scores; capped at 10 if not landable

landing.label: Landing Score
landing.text: How gentle and smooth the ground is (slope, roughness, relief).

sun_score.label: Sun Score
sun_score.text: Net solar energy over the period: what a {area_m2:g} m² panel harvests minus a {load_w:g} W continuous load, reduced by the battery mass needed to ride out the longest night.

signal.label: Signal Score
signal.text: Earth contact, reduced by long blackouts.

comfort.label: Comfort Score
comfort.text: How mild the temperatures are (cold floor and day-night swing).

views.label: Views Score
views.text: Closeness to famous landmarks (Apollo and Artemis sites, major craters).
views.formula: max of fame x exp(-distance / 100 km)

ice_score.label: Ice Score
ice_score.text: Proximity to permanently shadowed ice traps (polar plots only).
